title: Scottish
subtitle: Grease, starch and meat. It's the fish and chips we all like.

trails.title: Trail ① Stuffed Robber
trails.description: It's always hard to resist the temptation of food. They know how good fish and chips taste.

trails.title: Fish and Chips in the Kitchen
trails.description: The staff canteen is the best choice for filling the belly. Now you only need a bit more information to reach the fish and chips.

items.text: Scottish

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Finally, get them all to the corner.
Grr—

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm a bit hungry.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Oh right. I'll check what this padlock is made of and see if it can be consumed by the Shamirs ...
Checks it under the lights.
Very ordinary metal. It's just a common metal lock, with a bit of rust on the shackle.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see. With plenty of food on the ground, Shamirs won't notice the ironware hanging above.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Heh. Time to try a brand new dish, you old gentlemen.
Closes the door of the room and sneaks through the hallway. There is no light in here.
There are two guardhouses on each side of the hallway.
Pass by the rooms, and the front gate would be ahead. There is no lock on the gate.
Psst-psssst!
A gray-eyed boy pops his head up at the cell window.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Who are you?

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: I am "The Ring." I can catch anything with a toss.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Look!
He throws out an iron hoop, which is the size of a finger ring. The ring rolls over and clogs up Vertin's shoelaces.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So cool!

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: You can open these doors, can't you?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Can you help me out of here? And I swear I will be at your service.
How?

branch.speaker: “The Ring”
branch.text: Cast that special skill of yours and open this lock on my door ...

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: And so you can leave without a backward glance?

branch.speaker: “The Ring”
branch.text: Listen to you! I'm not going back in here again.

items.text: No way, mate.

branch.speaker: “The Ring”
branch.text: Fine. Thought we are on the same boat.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: If I let you out, will you come back?

branch.speaker: “The Ring”
branch.text: Of course not! Not even for a minute.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But if you don't come back, the instructor will give us a harsher punishment.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm just sneaking out for food. I'll be back.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What would you like to have?

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: ... Fish and chips. Some onion vinaigrette on the side, if they have any.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No problem. I will bring some mashed peas too.
Three hours later

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: So you managed to control the Shamirs and got out?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes. How about you? Any odd things in your room?

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Nothing peculiar. Just some stinky rats. Didn't even take me long to take care of them.
He shrugs his shoulders uncaringly and takes a good bite of the fish.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Nom-nom! The Staff Canteen does serve some good fish and chips ...

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: What you have in the Second Canteen is not even close to it! Keep missing the dressings and sometimes it's not even cod they fried!

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Hmm ... So, why are you here?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... I said "that word."

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: What word?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: "That word." I said it at the pre-parade assembly.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Oooh, you mean the S-word? At the school assembly?

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Hahahahahaha ...!

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Good for you ... Hahaha ... The Big Head is gonna be so pissed!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: *sighs* I don't understand ... It was he who said that I could ask any questions I want.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Where did you learn "that word"?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I heard it from the janitor of our dormitory. That was the last thing he said.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I saw him being escorted outside the school gate and onto a truck.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: He screamed all along, "The 'Storm' is coming ... The 'Storm' is coming ..."

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Er-m, I said it again ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Shoot.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Never mind, keep going.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... I asked many people, but none was bothered to answer. Uncle Morris said the janitor left the school at an inappropriate time and saw some inappropriate things, so he needed treatment.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: So I was right. The school is blocking the news feed.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What do you mean?

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Look at this. I snuck this out from the staff office.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: THE WORLD-CHANGING "STORM": TRUTH COVERED BY THE FOUNDATION?

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Yes. It wrote about a phenomenon called the "Storm," which will bring everybody in danger.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Yet, the Foundation has stayed in silence about it. We are not allowed to say "that word." And this is the evidence.
The newspaper has already become soft in hand after all the foldings. Some of its printings have even become blurry.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It doesn't tell us exactly what "that word" is, either.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There's a line in bold at the end of the article ... "Welcome to Manus Vindictae"?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What’s Manus Vindictae?

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Dunno, never heard of it.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Something has been printed on the back too. Hmm, let me see ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Nor happiness, nor harmony, nor fame,

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Nor pride, nor strength, nor skill in arms or arts,

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Shepherd those herds whom blindness makes tame;

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text:
Their eyes see not one light of Bright Stars.
               Men’s past ways are shaded by their shame,
               Paeans are but admiration’s mirror half.

               Tides run in blind by their ever-be routine,
               Staining that Heaven with obscene calamity.
               When folly wrecks wit, where do stand we? 

               Before a cruel whip? Man who man would be,
               Must rule the empire of himself; in it 
               Must be supreme, establishing his throne
               On vanquished will, quelling the challenges
               Of hopes and fears, being himself alone.
The night is quiet.
Yet disturbances are about to come out of the dark.
Squeak, squeak.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: What's going on? Great, the chips have brought in more rats!

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Vertin? Vertin!

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Do you have to drift off now? Come over and help!
TO BE CONTINUED…
